a simple supervised object detection algorithm with few shot training on a target domain can generalize across multiple document domains.
we propose a methodology to address document layout understanding using object detection and show that it can be applied to multiple domains using transfer learning.
a simple object detector can be used for document layout understanding across multiple domains using transfer learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a simple algorithm which can be trained on few documents and generalized to other documents in different domains.

our methodology can be applied on a variety of document domains with very few examples per domain, which can be further improved by using more examples.
we show a methodology to perform few shot object detection in document layout understanding and demonstrate the effect of transfer learning, domain specific fine-tuning and few-shot training.
we propose a simple methodology to train object detectors on few samples per class and use it for document understanding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that we can train a document layout understanding model using just few examples per document domain and the model is able to generalize across domains.
we can train a document layout understanding model using few shot object detection and this can be used for multiple domains.
we have shown that a simple object detector can be made domain specific by using a simple methodology of transfer learning and fine-tuning.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed methodology can be used in real-world scenarios where large annotated datasets are not readily available and can be used to train a domain specific object detector with few examples per domain.

a simple methodology can achieve state of the art results with very little data.
